briefdescription.para: C++ header file with declarations for the µTest++ extension concepts.

detaileddescription.para: This header provides the C++20 concepts that the applications use to extend the framework with their own comparators, operators, and helpers (the expressions they return, extension::compare_op and extension::predicate_op, are declared in detail.h): the concepts that detect the framework expression types, and the types accepted by expect(), require(), and the message operator.

The public concepts, and the templates compare_op and predicate_op, reside within the micro_os_plus::micro_test_plus::extension namespace, separate from the top namespace, so that using namespace on the top namespace does not bring their generic names into the application code.
The concepts used only by the implementation, which detect the framework constants, the containers, and the strings, reside within the detail namespace.
The marker base detail::op of the framework expression types is defined here; the deprecated value wrappers, in the detail namespace, are declared in deprecated.h.
The deprecated v5.0.1 type_traits namespace, which refers to these concepts and to the value wrappers, is declared in deprecated.h.
This file is included by micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus.h, which is the header that the applications include.
